title: 5. Dressing for Company
text: In a small and neat treatise just published, called the "Philosophy of Manner," we find the following good advice :--" When you receive company into your house, you should never appear in full dress. This is a circumstance of the first importance in good breeding." It might have been as well to say that the rule is, "never to dress better than your company-always dress in an inferior style," because if you dress better, you are apt to hurt their feelings by making them appear your inferiors.
